title: Runepowder Vial
summary: Destroy to trigger a 20-ft Force blast and knockback.

fields.Activation: Action to Throw. Detonates when destroyed at 0 of its 4 HP. A throw that does not destroy it can leave it inert. A nearby blast that destroys it can trigger another detonation.
fields.Blast: 20 ft actual radius, larger than the aiming preview. Deals 5d4 + 18 Force. DC 12 Dexterity save halves damage. Creatures are knocked back 20 ft without a save.
fields.Objects: The tooltip describes a critical hit against objects and terrain. The source instead reports an extra 23 Force without doubling the damage dice.
fields.Throw: Lightweight vial typically throws up to 60 ft. Throw impact deals 1 Bludgeoning to it. About 43 ft of fall can supply the other 3 HP of damage. A Fire surface can detonate it if it exhausts its HP.
fields.Acquisition: Philomeen can give the single vial in Grymforge during Find Explosives. No purchase or Alchemy recipe.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
